apps.summary: Play complete solo or pass-and-play backgammon on one Kobo.
apps.page_description: Play a tactile 24-point backgammon board built for Kobo's paper-like display.
apps.release_notes: Rebuild for protocol 12 so the Store listing matches Cobalt 0.3.2.

apps.summary: Browse and read books from your calibre-web library.
apps.page_description: Connect your calibre-web library and browse its books from your Kobo.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS calibre-web or calibre content-server OPDS endpoint ready.
For a private library, install its username and password as the named Basic credential used by the app.
If the server uses a private certificate authority, install that trust root separately.

apps.release_notes: Connect your calibre-web library and browse its books from your Kobo.

apps.summary: Solve a compact touch-first crossword with clue navigation.
apps.page_description: Work through a compact crossword with cell-by-cell touch entry and clue navigation.
apps.release_notes: Work through a compact crossword with cell-by-cell touch entry and clue navigation.

apps.summary: Turn your Kobo into a remote control for your computer.
apps.page_description: Pair with your computer and run favorite actions from large, clear controls.

steps.text: Create ~/.config/kobo/sidekick/deck.toml with the pages and controls you want on the reader.
Initialize the companion daemon to obtain its address, certificate, and pairing code.
Install the daemon certificate on the Kobo before pairing.

apps.release_notes: Pair with your computer and run favorite actions from large, clear controls.

apps.summary: Save public AO3 works to a shelf made for offline reading.
apps.page_description: Add an AO3 work and keep it ready for comfortable reading on your Kobo.
apps.release_notes: Add an AO3 work and keep it ready for comfortable reading on your Kobo.

apps.summary: Log bird sightings anywhere and build your life list.
apps.page_description: A field-ready eBird companion for quick sightings, species lookup, life lists, and checklist sharing.
apps.release_notes: A field-ready eBird companion for quick sightings, species lookup, life lists, and checklist sharing.

apps.summary: Review flashcards anywhere, even without Wi-Fi.
apps.page_description: Study with large reveal and answer controls designed for a Kobo screen.
apps.release_notes: Study with large reveal and answer controls designed for a Kobo screen.

apps.summary: Show computer-pushed monochrome photos in awake or scheduled slideshow modes.
apps.page_description: Turn a Kobo into a low-power monochrome photo frame with bounded, owner-pushed albums and awake or scheduled slideshow modes.

steps.text: Enable Cobalt's owner-attended SSH path and install this computer's public key.
Create Frame's private shelf through the established SSH connection.
Prepare and atomically push a photo or folder from this computer.

apps.release_notes: Turn a Kobo into a low-power monochrome photo frame with bounded, owner-pushed albums and awake or scheduled slideshow modes.

apps.summary: Browse offline SRD references and manage tabletop combat.
apps.page_description: Offline SRD reference and table tools for spell lookups, monster stat blocks, dice, initiative, and party HP.
apps.release_notes: Offline SRD reference and table tools for spell lookups, monster stat blocks, dice, initiative, and party HP.

apps.summary: Track daily and weekday habits with local streaks.
apps.page_description: An offline-first habit tracker that puts today's commitments and streaks on a calm paper display.
apps.release_notes: An offline-first habit tracker that puts today's commitments and streaks on a calm paper display.

apps.summary: Control saved Home Assistant tiles from a low-power panel.
apps.page_description: Keep your favorite Home Assistant controls on a simple, low-power panel.

steps.text: Expose Home Assistant through HTTPS, using Nabu Casa or a reverse proxy with a trusted certificate.
Create a Home Assistant long-lived access token and install it under the exact name homeassistant.
For a private certificate authority, install its root on the Kobo.

apps.release_notes: Keep your favorite Home Assistant controls on a simple, low-power panel.

apps.summary: Solve a fresh five-letter puzzle each day.
apps.page_description: A daily five-letter word puzzle you can play anywhere, with or without Wi-Fi.
apps.release_notes: A daily five-letter word puzzle you can play anywhere, with or without Wi-Fi.

apps.summary: Keep Mealie recipes handy in a counter-friendly cooking view.
apps.page_description: A Mealie companion that keeps tonight's recipe legible, awake, and usable offline at the counter.

steps.text: Make the Mealie API available to the Kobo at https://mealie.local.
Create a long-lived Mealie API token and install it under the exact name mealie.

apps.release_notes: A Mealie companion that keeps tonight's recipe legible, awake, and usable offline at the counter.

apps.summary: Solve chess puzzles and check correspondence games.
apps.page_description: Keep an endless set of chess puzzles ready and follow slower games on your Kobo.

steps.text: Anonymous puzzle use needs no account. Account play requires a Lichess personal access token.
Install the token under the exact name lichess.

apps.release_notes: Keep an endless set of chess puzzles ready and follow slower games on your Kobo.

apps.summary: Play four touch-first pencil puzzles.
apps.page_description: A daily collection of familiar logic puzzles with paper-like marks and large controls.
apps.release_notes: A daily collection of familiar logic puzzles with paper-like marks and large controls.

apps.summary: Read music scores with setlists and half-page turns.
apps.page_description: A Kobo score reader with stable stand mode, setlists, and two-stage half-page turns.
apps.release_notes: A Kobo score reader with stable stand mode, setlists, and two-stage half-page turns.

apps.summary: Count rows, browse Ravelry collections, and read your synced patterns offline.
apps.page_description: A knuckle-sized row counter, Ravelry library browser, and offline pattern reader.

steps.text: Ravelry library sync requires an approved Ravelry API account and HTTP Basic credential.
Install the credential under the exact name ravelry.
Prepare and transfer a PDF you own with Poppler's pdftotext installed.

apps.release_notes: A knuckle-sized row counter, Ravelry library browser, and offline pattern reader.

apps.summary: Solve a bundled touch-first picture grid offline.
apps.page_description: Solve a touch-first picture grid by cycling each square through fill, X, and blank.
apps.release_notes: Solve a touch-first picture grid by cycling each square through fill, X, and blank.

apps.summary: Read comics added from your computer or Komga library.
apps.page_description: Enjoy your comics on Kobo with clear page controls and support for Komga libraries.

steps.text: Local CBZ reading needs no service. Komga mode requires an HTTPS Komga OPDS endpoint.
For a private Komga library, install its HTTP Basic credential under the exact name komga.

apps.release_notes: Enjoy your comics on Kobo with clear page controls and support for Komga libraries.

apps.summary: Pair with a computer to mirror a terminal session on e-ink.
apps.page_description: Pair a Kobo with a computer to read a terminal session on an e-ink display.

steps.text: Initialize the terminal companion and note the address and pairing code.
Install the terminal companion certificate on the Kobo.
Start a mirrored terminal with the controls needed on the reader.

apps.release_notes: Pair a Kobo with a computer to read a terminal session on an e-ink display.

apps.summary: Play touch-first Reversi together on one Kobo.
apps.page_description: A pass-and-play board-game shelf, beginning with touch-first Reversi.
apps.release_notes: A pass-and-play board-game shelf, beginning with touch-first Reversi.

apps.summary: Play an original interactive story without Wi-Fi.
apps.page_description: Explore an original text adventure with touch shortcuts and a comfortable reading layout.
apps.release_notes: Explore an original text adventure with touch shortcuts and a comfortable reading layout.

apps.summary: Read and reply to letters from Hermes.
apps.page_description: A calm, letter-style inbox for thoughtful messages you can read anywhere.

steps.text: Deploy a compatible Hermes gateway behind HTTPS and note its public URL.
Install the gateway bearer token under the exact name hermes-post.

apps.release_notes: A calm, letter-style inbox for thoughtful messages you can read anywhere.

apps.summary: Play offline solo or pass-around trivia rounds.
apps.page_description: Offline trivia rounds for one reader or a table passing one Kobo between players.
apps.release_notes: Offline trivia rounds for one reader or a table passing one Kobo between players.

apps.summary: Read your Wallabag articles anywhere.
apps.page_description: Bring saved Wallabag articles to your Kobo, then archive or favorite them as you read.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Wallabag instance and a bearer credential accepted by its API.
Install that credential under the exact name wallabag.

apps.release_notes: Bring saved Wallabag articles to your Kobo, then archive or favorite them as you read.

apps.summary: Read your Miniflux feeds anywhere.
apps.page_description: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi.

steps.text: Have an HTTPS Miniflux instance, either self-hosted or hosted, and create an API token.
Install the token under the exact name miniflux; the runtime sends it as X-Auth-Token.

apps.release_notes: Bring unread Miniflux articles to your Kobo and keep reading without Wi-Fi.

apps.summary: Choose folders and a battery-friendly sync schedule.
apps.page_description: Keep selected folders in sync while controlling when your Kobo uses Wi-Fi.

steps.text: Sync requires a Cobalt platform build containing the pinned ARMv7 Syncthing engine and a package-manager-installed Syncthing binary on your computer.
Pair exactly one local directory to a fixed safe folder while the Kobo is awake on Wi-Fi.
Resume Sync on the Kobo, then start the private host peer. It does not modify another Syncthing installation.

apps.release_notes: Keep selected folders in sync while controlling when your Kobo uses Wi-Fi.

apps.summary: Browse your notes by folder, tag, link, and backlink.
apps.page_description: Keep a searchable copy of your note library ready to read on your Kobo.
apps.release_notes: Keep a searchable copy of your note library ready to read on your Kobo.

apps.summary: Read a public-domain poem each day.
apps.page_description: Discover a daily poem, browse its source, and keep favorites for later.
apps.release_notes: Discover a daily poem, browse its source, and keep favorites for later.
